title: A purlis theme folder's theme.json (format 2)
description: A theme: a name, optionally the theme it extends, a palette of named colours, its icon set, its appearances, each tagged dark or light and optionally high contrast, what compact draws, its fonts, its options, how a workspace's colour tints it, and its component parts. purlis refuses a theme that breaks this grammar and draws Purlis in its place.

name.description: What to call the theme, as a person would.

extends.description: The id of the theme this one starts from: purlis-classic, or a theme folder's name. This theme holds only what differs.

palette.description: Named colours, hex only. A token names one by its name; the names are this theme's own.

appearances.description: The theme's appearances, the first what it draws when nothing chose another. One with an id its parent has layers over that one.

options.description: The theme's options: toggles and choices, each value a layer of token values drawn over every appearance. There are no free-number options. A theme has at most 64 combinations of appearance and option values, the appearances times each option's number of values (a toggle has two), and one past that is refused with its count. An option with the id of one in the theme it extends takes its place.

icons.description: The theme's icon set: the path of a JSON file inside this theme's folder, such as icons/icons.json, that draws each view's tab on the rails. A view it does not draw is the parent's.

compact.description: What compact draws, for every appearance, when the person chose compact density: geometry tokens and their numbers. A token not named is the smaller of Purlis Classic's compact and the appearance's own where Classic's compact moves it, else the appearance's own.

fonts.description: The UI, mono and terminal fonts, each from woff2 files in this folder's fonts/. A font not named is the parent's, or the platform's.

tint.description: How a workspace's colour tints this theme. A key not given is the parent's, or Purlis Classic's.

on.description: false: a workspace's colour tints nothing in this theme.

tokens.description: The tokens a workspace's colour turns. The strip shades (layer.*) are tinted on a workspace's own tab and chat strip; the rest on the whole window too.

hues.description: A workspace colour's hue in this theme: the hue of this colour. A workspace's own #rrggbb is always its own hue.

parts.description: Component parts (manifest version 6): keys <family>.<part>[.<variant>][.<state>].<property>, the state at rest implied. A property not named is the family default. Inside a state only fill, text, border-colour and shadow may be set: a state never changes a part's size. `purlis theme parts` lists every family, part, state and property with its bounds.

colour.description: A hex colour, or the name of a colour in this theme's palette.

appearance.description: Whether it is drawn on a dark window or a light one. Required unless the theme it extends has an appearance of this id.

tokens.description: Token values: a colour for a colour token; for a flag, the terminal cursor's shape or its line height, a value of that type; a number in its bound for a geometry token. A token not named is the parent's, or Purlis Classic's of the same appearance; text.quiet not named takes the text.muted named beside it while the layer below draws quiet in its muted, and text.faint not named takes the quiet while the layer below draws faint in its quiet.

easing.standard.description: A cubic Bézier, [x1, y1, x2, y2]: each x from 0 to 1, each y from -1 to 2.

easing.enter.description: A cubic Bézier, [x1, y1, x2, y2]: each x from 0 to 1, each y from -1 to 2.

easing.steady.description: A cubic Bézier, [x1, y1, x2, y2]: each x from 0 to 1, each y from -1 to 2.

easing.breathe.description: A cubic Bézier, [x1, y1, x2, y2]: each x from 0 to 1, each y from -1 to 2.

family.description: What the font is called, as Settings says it.

file.description: A woff2 file in this folder's fonts/: never a URL or a path out of the folder.

layer.description: Token values drawn over every appearance (tokens), and over one appearance by its id (appearances), after the first.

oneOf.description: A toggle: on or off. Its on layer is drawn when it is on.
A choice: one of its named values, each a layer.

default.description: The id of the value drawn when nothing chose one.

part-fill.description: Its fill: a semantic colour token, or transparent.

part-text.description: Its words' and icons' colour: a semantic colour token.

part-border-colour.description: Its border's colour: a semantic colour token, or transparent.

part-shadow.description: Its shadow: an elevation step, none, raised or overlay.

part-border-width.description: Its border's width in px, 0 for none.

part-corner-radius.description: Its corners: one value or four (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left), each px, a radius token or full; drawn at most half its height.

part-padding.description: The room inside it: one value, or two (block, inline), each px at the default text size or a space token.

part-gap.description: The room between what it holds: px at the default text size or a space token.

part-font-size.description: Its words' size: px at the default text size or a font-size token.

part-font-weight.description: Its words' weight, or a font-weight token.

part-height.description: Its height: px at the default text size or a size token.
